newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA leads HK$600 mln FRCDs for Shanghai Bank.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA leads HK$600 mln FRCDs for Shanghai Bank.

text.p: The Commonwealth Bank of Australia said it has been mandated to lead a HK$600 million of floating rate certificates of deposit (FRCD) facility for Shanghai Commercial Bank.
The FRCDs will pay a coupon of HIBOR plus 0.35 percent for its five year tenure. The certificates will have put and call options exerciseable after three years.
The issue is expected to be launched this week in loan style syndication in Hong Kong.
The CBA would act as fiscal and paying agent to the issue and would be joined in the lead mangement role by Societe Generale Asia.

This is CBA's third lead manager role in Hong Kong dollar transactions following two successful fixed coupon issues in 1996 for the European Investment Bank and Deutsche Seidlungs und Landesrentenbank.
Shanghai Commercial Bank, established in 1950, is one of the leading locally incorporated banks and one of six Hong Kong banks rated at the Hong Kong ceiling level of A3 by Moody's Investors service.
